sentences.zh: 这种垂直喷射式的饮水机，讽刺地被称为“卫生饮水机”。

sentences.en: And in 1920, the American Water Works Association issued a sternly worded report that begins,
sentences.zh: 1920年，美国水务协会发布了一份措辞严厉的报告，开头写道：

sentences.en: The war against the common drinking cup has been won.
sentences.zh: 反对公用饮水杯的战争已经胜利。

sentences.en: This victory, however, must not be allowed to blind us to the dangers lurking in the sanitary drinking fountain.
sentences.zh: 然而，这场胜利绝不能让我们对潜伏在卫生饮水机中的危险视而不见。

sentences.en: The report goes on to detail a study of one of these so-called sanitary drinking fountains.
sentences.zh: 报告随后详细介绍了一项针对这些所谓“卫生饮水机”的研究。

sentences.en: Of the 47 people who used the fountain, in almost every instance, the lips were placed completely around the metal ball from which the water spurted.
sentences.zh: 在使用饮水机的47人中，几乎所有人在喝水时，嘴唇都完全包住了喷水的金属球。

sentences.en: And one small boy acted as though he were trying to swallow the whole machinery.
sentences.zh: 还有一个小男孩表现得好像想把整个机器吞下去一样。

sentences.en: It goes on.
sentences.zh: 报告继续写道。

sentences.en: Of the 47 people, three looked as though they were unmistakably victims of tuberculosis.
sentences.zh: 在这47人中，有三人看起来明显是肺结核患者。

sentences.en: And three had eruptions on their faces.
sentences.zh: 还有三人脸上长有皮疹。

sentences.en: They advised putting cages around the spouts so that we couldn't wrap our mouths around them.
sentences.zh: 他们建议在喷嘴周围安装防护罩，这样我们就无法用嘴包住它们了。

sentences.en: And finally, they advised switching to a slanted or arced jet of water.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们建议改用倾斜或弧形的水流。

sentences.en: This, along with the guard around the spout, proved to be the design that stuck.
sentences.zh: 这一点，加上喷嘴周围的防护罩，被证明是最终沿用下来的设计。

sentences.en: Finally, a drinking fountain we could all get behind.
sentences.zh: 终于，我们都支持这种饮水机了。

sentences.en: Sort of.
sentences.zh: 算是吧。

sentences.en: I say segregation now, segregation tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我说现在要隔离，明天也要隔离。

sentences.en: For a lot of Americans, the public drinking fountain conjures an image that has nothing to do with the slanted jet or the common cup or with temperance.
sentences.zh: 对于许多美国人来说，公共饮水机唤起了一种与倾斜水流、公用杯或禁酒运动毫无关系的形象。

sentences.en: It's an image of segregation.
sentences.zh: 那是一种种族隔离的形象。

sentences.en: The segregated drinking fountain during the Jim Crow era in the South is one of the images that haunts us, right?
sentences.zh: 吉姆·克劳法时期南方那种种族隔离的饮水机，是困扰我们的形象之一，对吧？

sentences.en: Sharing water made racist America uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 共享水源让种族主义的美国感到不安。

sentences.en: Whether it was drinking fountains or swimming pools.
sentences.zh: 无论是饮水机还是游泳池。

sentences.en: There's this huge anxiety about the contact of black and white bodies.
sentences.zh: 人们对黑人和白人身体的接触有着巨大的焦虑。

sentences.en: The Civil Rights Act of 1964 ended segregated public facilities, including drinking fountains.
sentences.zh: 1964年的《民权法案》终结了包括饮水机在内的公共设施种族隔离。

sentences.en: Although a handful hung on in the South for a few more years.
sentences.zh: 尽管在南方，这种现象又持续了几年。

sentences.en: Even with that darkest period of the drinking fountains history over,
sentences.zh: 即使饮水机历史上最黑暗的时期已经过去，

sentences.en: it's never really been as beloved as it was when they opened that first one in London in 1859.
sentences.zh: 它也从未像1859年伦敦刚开设第一台饮水机时那样受到人们的喜爱。

sentences.en: Recently, public drinking fountains have met their most formidable opponent.
sentences.zh: 最近，公共饮水机遇到了它最强大的对手。

sentences.en: So in the United States, we consume 9 or 10 billion gallons a year of expensive bottled water.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们每年消耗90到100亿加仑昂贵的瓶装水。

sentences.en: And it's growing 5 to 10 percent a year.
sentences.zh: 而且每年以5%到10%的速度增长。

sentences.en: That's Peter Glick again of the Pacific Institute.
sentences.zh: 这是太平洋研究所的彼得·格利克再次提到的。

sentences.en: He also wrote a book called Bottled and Sold, the story behind our obsession with bottled water.
sentences.zh: 他还写了一本书叫《瓶装与销售》，讲述了我们对瓶装水痴迷背后的故事。

sentences.en: The consequence of that is billions and billions of plastic bottles that have to be thrown away or recycled.
sentences.zh: 其后果就是数十亿个塑料瓶必须被丢弃或回收。

sentences.en: Another consequence, drinking fountains are starting to disappear from the public landscape.
sentences.zh: 另一个后果是，饮水机开始从公共景观中消失。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that many people believe public water is sort of a standard part of any urban design,
sentences.zh: 尽管许多人认为公共供水是任何城市设计的标准组成部分，

sentences.en: we have seen movement away from water fountains.
sentences.zh: 但我们已经看到人们开始远离饮水机了。

sentences.en: The University of Central Florida, in 2007, opened a brand new football stadium.
sentences.zh: 2007年，中佛罗里达大学开设了一个全新的足球场。

sentences.en: They had built the stadium with no public water fountains.
sentences.zh: 他们在建造体育场时没有安装公共饮水机。

sentences.en: And on opening day, 45,000 people showed up to watch the UCF Knights play the Texas Longhorns.
sentences.zh: 在开幕当天，4.5万人涌入观看中佛罗里达大学骑士队对阵德克萨斯长角牛队的比赛。

sentences.en: It was an incredibly hot day.
sentences.zh: 那天天气热得惊人。

sentences.en: Almost 100 degrees, so everyone was thirsty.
sentences.zh: 气温接近100华氏度（约38摄氏度），所以每个人都很渴。

sentences.en: Bottled water was for sale, of course, but it cost $3.
sentences.zh: 当然有瓶装水卖，但要3美元一瓶。

sentences.en: And then the bottled water sold out.
sentences.zh: 后来瓶装水卖光了。

sentences.en: Eighteen people were taken to hospitals, and 60 more were treated by local campus personnel for heat-related illnesses.
sentences.zh: 18人被送往医院，另有60人因高温相关疾病接受了当地校园医护人员的治疗。

sentences.en: At first, the university was unapologetic.
sentences.zh: 起初，校方毫无歉意。

sentences.en: And then some angry students organized into a group called Knights for Free Water.
sentences.zh: 随后，一些愤怒的学生组织了一个名为“骑士争取免费水”的团体。

sentences.en: They demanded drinking fountains be installed in the stadium.
sentences.zh: 他们要求在体育场内安装饮水机。

sentences.en: We're not out for blood, we just want water, they said.
sentences.zh: 他们说：“我们不是要闹事，我们只是想要水。”

sentences.en: The local press came up with a name for the scandal.
sentences.zh: 当地媒体为这起丑闻起了一个名字。

sentences.en: You'll never guess.
sentences.zh: 你绝对猜不到。

sentences.en: Yes, it was Watergate.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是“水门事件”。

sentences.en: And finally, the university was forced to concede.
sentences.zh: 最终，校方被迫让步。

sentences.en: They installed 50 drinking fountains in their stadium.
sentences.zh: 他们在体育场内安装了50台饮水机。

sentences.en: The Knights for Free Water probably didn't know anything about their foremothers and fathers
sentences.zh: “骑士争取免费水”组织可能并不了解他们的前辈们，

sentences.en: and the Metropolitan Free Drinking Fountain and Cattle Trough Association.
sentences.zh: 以及“大都会免费饮水机与牲畜水槽协会”。

sentences.en: But it's because of them and their teetotaling brethren in the United States
sentences.zh: 但正是因为他们以及美国那些滴酒不沾的同道中人，

sentences.en: that we've come to expect access to clean, free water in public places.
sentences.zh: 我们才得以期望在公共场所获得干净、免费的水。

sentences.en: If Watergate proved anything, you know, besides Nixon was a liar and a cheat,
sentences.zh: 如果说“水门事件”证明了什么，你知道的，除了尼克松是个骗子和无赖之外，

sentences.en: it's that drinking fountains still matter.
sentences.zh: 那就是饮水机依然很重要。

sentences.en: And when they're gone, we notice.
sentences.zh: 当它们消失时，我们就会注意到。

sentences.en: Because even though we as a society have mostly rejected the idea of temperance
sentences.zh: 因为尽管我们作为一个社会已经基本拒绝了禁酒运动的理念，

sentences.en: and embraced the idea that we love booze forever,
sentences.zh: 并拥抱了我们永远热爱酒精的观念，

sentences.en: sometimes water is still the beSt.
sentences.zh: 但有时水依然是最好的。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Marta Gutman.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢玛塔·古特曼。

sentences.en: A talk she gave on her book City for Children, Women Architecture,
sentences.zh: 她关于自己的书《儿童城市、女性建筑》所做的一次演讲，

sentences.en: and the Charitable Landscapes of Oakland inspired this story.
sentences.zh: 以及奥克兰的慈善景观，激发了这个故事的灵感。

sentences.en: Bonus fact.
sentences.zh: 额外事实。

sentences.en: The Metropolitan Free Drinking Fountain and Cattle Trough Association still exists,
sentences.zh: “大都会免费饮水机与牲畜水槽协会”依然存在，

sentences.en: but they changed their name again.
sentences.zh: 但他们再次更改了名字。

sentences.en: Now they're juSt.
sentences.zh: 现在他们叫，

sentences.zh: “饮水机协会”。

sentences.en: They still maintain London's historic fountains
sentences.zh: 他们仍在维护伦敦的历史性饮水机，

sentences.en: and build new ones in developing countries.
sentences.zh: 并在发展中国家建造新的饮水机。

sentences.en: The design group we mentioned at the beginning of the piece,
sentences.zh: 我们在节目开头提到的设计团队，

sentences.en: Pilot Projects, is trying to build 100 new drinking fountains in New York.
sentences.zh: “试点项目”，正试图在纽约建造100台新的饮水机。

sentences.en: They're still trying to make it happen,
sentences.zh: 他们仍在努力实现这一目标，

sentences.en: but they need the city to partner with them.
sentences.zh: 但他们需要市政府与他们合作。

sentences.en: If you're really into this, write a note to the mayor's office
sentences.zh: 如果你对此非常感兴趣，给市长办公室写封信，

sentences.en: and ask for better drinking fountains
sentences.zh: 要求提供更好的饮水机，

sentences.en: and mention the 100 Fountains Project as part of the solution.
sentences.zh: 并提到“100台饮水机项目”作为解决方案的一部分。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Katie Mingle
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由凯蒂·明格尔制作，

sentences.en: with Sam Greenspan, Avery Truffman, Kurt Colstead, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 参与制作的还有萨姆·格林斯潘、艾弗里·特鲁夫曼、库尔特·科尔斯特德以及我，罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 在ArcSign的办公室制作，

sentences.zh: 这是一家建筑与室内设计公司，

sentences.zh: 位于美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心。

sentences.zh: 当凯蒂制作这期节目时，

sentences.en: we collectively couldn't get the Toon Yard song
sentences.zh: 我们大家脑子里都挥之不去Toon Yard的那首歌，

sentences.en: Water Fountain out of our heads,
sentences.zh: 《饮水机》，

sentences.en: and it just so happens that Rishi at Song Exploder
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，Song Exploder的里希，

sentences.en: did an episode about that song,
sentences.zh: 做了一期关于那首歌的节目，

sentences.en: which was one of our absolute favorite episodes,
sentences.zh: 那也是我们最喜欢的节目之一，

sentences.en: so we thought we'd add it here as a little bonus.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想把它作为一点小福利加在这里。

sentences.zh: 我会绕着那个湖走很多圈，
